title: Movies About a Marriage Falling Apart
intro: Nobody screams at first. It is the small things that pile up until the house cannot hold them.

films.title: Marriage Story
films.blurb: Noah Baumbach wrote it after his own divorce, and it shows in the details: the mediator's exercise nobody finishes, the lawyer who is kind until she isn't. Scarlett Johansson and Adam Driver play a theatre couple splitting across two coasts with a small son between them. Six Oscar nominations, and Laura Dern won every supporting-actress award going. The fight in the empty apartment is why this film is a meme and a wound at the same time.

films.title: Anatomy of a Fall
films.blurb: A husband is found dead below the chalet, and the only ones home were a visually impaired boy and his dog. Sandra Hüller plays the wife on trial, and the trial slowly turns into an autopsy of the marriage instead: who wrote what, who gave up what, who resented whom. It won the Palme d'Or and the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay. Asked whether Sandra did it, Justine Triet said she would tell us in 10 years.

films.title: Thappad
films.blurb: One slap at a party, in front of everyone, and Amrita cannot do what everyone tells her to do, which is forget it. Anubhav Sinha's film is about the little unfairnesses that a single moment lights up all at once. She asks for no alimony. She just wants it understood that he had no right. Taapsee Pannu won Best Actress at the Filmfare Awards, where the film took 7 of its 15 nominations.

films.title: Malcolm & Marie
films.blurb: One house, one night, one argument in black and white. A director comes home from his premiere and forgets to thank the girlfriend whose life he just put on screen. Zendaya and John David Washington go at each other for two hours in a film written, financed and shot in secret during lockdown, the first Hollywood feature made entirely inside it. The critics were split. Couples who have watched it together are not.

films.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
films.blurb: Dustin Hoffman was going through his own divorce and turned the part down at first. Meryl Streep was cast in a smaller role and forced her way into an audition for Joanna instead. What they made won five Oscars including Best Picture and was the biggest film of 1979 in America. A mother walks out, a father learns to make French toast, and a custody fight neither of them can win. It refuses to pick a side.

films.title: Gone Girl
films.blurb: On their fifth anniversary Nick comes home and Amy is gone. Gillian Flynn adapted her own novel, and Fincher kept her on for the whole project instead of swapping in a screenwriter after the first draft, which almost never happens. Rosamund Pike's Amy earned an Oscar nomination, the film took $370 million, and the cool girl monologue is still quoted. A thriller on the surface and a marriage underneath, which is the scarier film.
